system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — RadioShack Corporation realized record, fixed ~2016–2018 window

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. The outcome window is FIXED at ~2016–2018 (three to
> five years after the ~2013 closing). This sub-dossier contains no information about how
> the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status across the fixed outcome window
- The registrant's last Annual Report on Form 10-K was for fiscal year ended December 31, 2013,
  filed March 4, 2014; no Form 10-K or other periodic report was filed for any fiscal year in the
  ~2016–2018 outcome window. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-14-000005, Form 10-K cover]
- The registrant's common stock was delisted (Form 25-NSE filed March 20, 2015) and its Exchange Act
  registration was terminated (Form 15-12B filed October 8, 2015), both before the outcome window
  opened, so no audited public financial statements exist for the ~2016–2018 window. [SRC: SEC accession 0000876661-15-000132, Form 25-NSE] [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-340454, Form 15-12B]
- Consequently the realized record for the transaction within the fixed ~2016–2018 window is not
  publicly observable, and the outcome is coded **uncertain** on that basis; the documented
  pre-window trajectory below is recorded to show why no in-window public record exists. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-340454, Form 15-12B]

## Documented pre-window realized trajectory (before the outcome window; primary filings)
- For fiscal 2013 the registrant reported a net loss of $400.2 million, compared with a loss of
  $139.4 million in 2012 — the best-documented realized scalar. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-14-000005, Form 10-K MD&A]
- Cash and cash equivalents fell to $179.8 million at December 31, 2013 from $535.7 million at
  December 31, 2012. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-14-000005, Form 10-K MD&A Liquidity Outlook]
- On March 4, 2014 the registrant announced a program to close up to 1,100 underperforming stores,
  which produced a non-cash fixed-asset impairment charge of $11.2 million and an inventory write-down
  of $10.1 million reflected in the 2013 financial statements. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-14-000005, Form 10-K MD&A Store Closure Program]
- On February 2, 2015 the NYSE determined the registrant's common stock should be delisted, citing
  market capitalization and stockholders' equity below the $50 million continued-listing minimums;
  trading was suspended after the close that day. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-15-000007, Form 8-K Item 3.01]
- On February 5, 2015 RadioShack Corporation and its direct and indirect domestic subsidiaries filed
  voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware, entering a
  Debtor-in-Possession credit facility of approximately $285 million. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-044358, Form 8-K Item 1.01]
- In subsequent 2015 filings the registrant reported under the changed name "RS Legacy Corporation."
  [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-15-000015, Form 8-K registrant name]

## Bearing on the specific transaction analyzed
- The Chapter 11 filing states that the Company's operating subsidiaries in Mexico and Asia were NOT
  Debtors under the Chapter 11 Cases — the Asian in-market operations relevant to the analyzed
  transaction sat outside the U.S. parent's bankruptcy estate. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-044358, Form 8-K Item 1.01]
- No retrieved public primary filing documents the subsequent trajectory, continuation, or wind-down
  of the specific Asian retail entity after the parent's 2015 delisting/deregistration; its
  post-2015 status is not publicly observable in the record retrieved. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- Because the registrant delisted and deregistered in 2015 — after a fiscal-2013 net loss of $400.2
  million, a March 2014 program to close up to 1,100 stores, and a February 5, 2015 Chapter 11 filing
  — there is no public audited outcome record for the fixed ~2016–2018 window, and the transaction's
  in-window realized record (with the Asian operations expressly outside the parent's bankruptcy
  estate) is not publicly observable; the outcome is therefore coded **uncertain**. [SRC: SEC accession 0000096289-14-000005, Form 10-K MD&A] [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-044358, Form 8-K Item 1.01] [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-15-340454, Form 15-12B]

[SLICE END]
